overview: A lunar image registration and correspondence analysis workbench for space technology, letting users register multi-modal lunar imagery (OHRC, TMC-2, IIRS, LRO NAC, SELENE) with a real in-browser computer vision pipeline, scientific integrity, and persistent experiment history.
features: Run a real in-browser image registration pipeline on demo lunar image pairs
Compare Similarity, Affine, and Homography transformation models with recommended-model selection
View correspondence points with inliers/outliers, spatial distribution, and match quality filtering
Analyze sun-angle, scale, and multi-modal robustness of registrations
Persist per-user experiment history and reproduce any job from its stored configuration
Export full results packages including registered images, correspondence data, metrics, and PDF reports
